text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While everyone else is enjoying the holidays, the Umamusume preparing for the Arima Kinen have not a moment to spare.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, that doesn't mean they won't be enjoying this festive season. I tell Oguri Cap to have lots of fun with her friends, but…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I've been waiting for you!
choice_data_list: Oguri?! What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's supposed to be having a party with Tamamo Cross, but for some reason, the room is covered in holiday decorations.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Sorry, I let myself in. I wanted to surprise you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: It's still going on. They didn't mind me slipping out for a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: After all, this is a very special time of year. I wanted to spend it with you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I thought it'd be nice to chat before the big day.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I told everyone how I felt, and they happily sent me on my way.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Actually, they were the ones who suggested the decorations. I'm so lucky to have such great rivals.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Not to mention a wonderful trainer.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Now let's get this party started!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: What would you like to eat first? Creek gave me all kinds of stuff to bring here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I take a proper look around me and notice the ridiculous amount of food—cake, pizza, salad, stew… and even amberjack.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh, so you noticed? Good eye!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Inari brought it. It's in season, so she thought it would be perfect for our celebration.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The flesh looks really plump and tasty, doesn't it? Actually, yeah. Let's start with the amberjack.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: First, we need to slice it up and simmer the head… Just thinking about how good it'll taste is enough to get me going!
choice_data_list: Aren't you going to dress it?
Aren't you going to dress it?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …Oh, right.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I don't think I know how to dress fish… Do you?
choice_data_list: With something this size, we should probably—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, I've got this.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: If anyone can swallow a fish whole, it's me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so my evening with Oguri Cap takes an interesting turn…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: This sure brings back memories. The holidays were always really fun back home as well.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The delicious food everyone made, the lively yet meaningful conversations we used to have…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: It was impossible to feel the winter chill with how warm everyone was.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I feel just as warm as I did back then.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: It's like all my tension and fatigue have melted away.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad to be able to spend this time with you. I want to hold on to the warmth I feel now…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: And use it when I compete in the Arima Kinen.
choice_data_list: Let's take all our cherished memories out there with us!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh, there's something important I forgot. I should've said this earlier, but…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Happy holidays!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so it is that Oguri Cap and I share a heartwarming evening together. I'll take this cherished memory with me to the Arima Kinen.
